totalWords = 0

currentSize = 0
tempSize = 0

            maxBracketLength = max(maxBracketLength, tempSize)

            totalWords += 1

            currentSize += 1
            if index == totalChars - 1:
                maxBracketLength = max(maxBracketLength, currentSize)
        else:
            if currentSize != 0:
                maxBracketLength = max(maxBracketLength, currentSize)
                currentSize = 0

print(f"{maxBracketLength} {totalWords}")
